rationale: The agent authenticated the user correctly using name+zip, identified the two pending t-shirt orders, obtained explicit confirmation before making changes, executed the modifications correctly with the correct variant (purple, S, polyester, v-neck), and accurately reported the small additional charges to the correct payment method. However, earlier the agent incorrectly stated the number of available t-shirt options as 11, while the product data shows only 10 available variants (two variants were unavailable). This constitutes incorrect information derived from the tools, so the overall interaction does not fully meet the pass bar.
